abide.ancient: To remain, stay, dwell. Not a visit -- it is moving in and living there.
abide.drift: Modern 'abide' sounds like merely tolerating; the Bible means settling down and staying put.

acceptable.drift: More than 'good enough' -- it is what delights him.

accuse.ancient: An accuser in court. Revelation calls Satan 'the accuser' -- it is his job title.
accuse.drift: When you feel accused, check who is speaking: conviction builds up, accusation tears down.

adam.ancient: Man, mankind -- from adamah, 'ground, earth.' Man is literally 'earthling.'
adam.drift: 'Adam' is not just a name; it is what we are: dirt that God breathed into.

adoption.ancient: Being placed as a son, with the full legal rights of a grown heir.
adoption.drift: Not rescue alone -- it is full family standing, inheritance and all.

adultery.ancient: Unfaithfulness in marriage; breaking the covenant of the bed.
adultery.drift: The Bible also uses it for spiritual unfaithfulness -- chasing other gods.

adversary.ancient: An opponent in a lawsuit; the other side in court.
adversary.drift: 'Your adversary the devil' (1 Pet 5:8) is courtroom language -- he is the prosecution.

agree.ancient: To sound together -- it is where the word 'symphony' comes from.
agree.drift: Agreement in the Bible is musical: many instruments, one sound.

almighty.ancient: Traditionally 'Almighty' -- God the all-sufficient, mountain-strong one.
almighty.drift: The exact root is debated, but every use shouts total sufficiency.

altar.ancient: A place of slaughter -- where something dies for worship.
altar.drift: Altars cost. Worship in the Bible is never cheap.

amen.ancient: Truly, surely, so be it -- from aman, 'to be firm, steady.'
amen.drift: Not a way to end a prayer; it is a stamp of agreement: 'I stand on that.'

angel.ancient: A messenger -- one sent with a message.
angel.drift: Not chubby babies with wings; God's mail carriers, sometimes warriors.

anger.ancient: Literally 'nose, nostril' -- anger pictured as flaring nostrils.
anger.drift: Hebrew is earthy: God's 'nose burns' when he is angry.

anoint.ancient: To smear or rub with oil -- how kings and priests were set apart.
anoint.drift: The root of 'Messiah' -- the Anointed One.

apostle.ancient: One sent out with authority; an ambassador, a messenger.
apostle.drift: Not a church rank or title -- it is a job description: sent one.

arise.ancient: To stand up, get up, rise to action.
arise.drift: God's wake-up word -- 'arise' means the waiting is over.

ark.drift: Just a box -- the glory was what it carried: God's presence.

armor.ancient: Full armor -- a Roman soldier's complete kit.
armor.drift: Ephesians 6 lists every piece with a spiritual twin. Half armor is no armor.

atonement.ancient: To cover -- sin covered by blood.
atonement.drift: English suggests 'at-one-ment'; the Hebrew pictures sin COVERED, hidden from judgment.

awake.ancient: To wake up, rouse -- egeiro is also the resurrection word.
awake.drift: The New Testament uses resurrection language for waking: every morning is a mini-Easter.

baptism.drift: A burial and a raising -- you go under as one person and come up another.

baptize.ancient: To dip, plunge, immerse -- dunked under.
baptize.drift: The word was never translated, just spelled in English letters. It means dunk, not sprinkle.

barren.drift: In the Bible barrenness always precedes a miracle: Sarah, Rebekah, Hannah, Elizabeth.

battle.ancient: War, fighting -- and 'the battle is the LORD's.'
battle.drift: Israel's wars were God's wars; victory never belonged to the bigger army.

behold.ancient: See! Look! -- a flag planted on the next words.
behold.drift: A highlighter pen: stop and look at THIS.

believe.ancient: To trust, rely on, put confidence in.
believe.drift: More than agreeing with facts -- it is trusting a bridge by walking on it.

beloved.drift: God's word over Jesus at his baptism -- and over you in him.

betray.drift: Judas 'handed over' Jesus -- the same word for God 'delivering up' his Son (Rom 8:32). Chilling parallel.

bible.ancient: 'The books' -- biblia is plural. The Bible is a library, not a single book.
bible.drift: Many books, many authors, one story: God's rescue plan.

bind.ancient: To tie, fasten; rabbis used it for 'forbid.'
bind.drift: 'Whatever you bind on earth' -- heaven's court language for forbidding and permitting.

bishop.ancient: An overseer, a guardian -- one who watches over the flock.
bishop.drift: A job description, not a rank: the early church's leaders were shepherds, not CEOs.

blameless.ancient: Without blemish -- sacrifice language; no defects allowed.
blameless.drift: A word from the altar, applied to YOU in Christ.

bless.ancient: To kneel, praise; to speak well of someone.
bless.drift: Blessing is kneeling-level honor -- and 'eulogeo' is where 'eulogy' comes from.

blessed.ancient: Happy, fortunate, deeply favored by God.
blessed.drift: Not a vague religious nicety -- it is congratulations from heaven.

blessing.ancient: A gift of good words and good things.
blessing.drift: Spoken first, then lived: blessing is pronounced before it is possessed.

blood.ancient: Life itself -- 'the life of the flesh is in the blood' (Lev 17:11).
blood.drift: 'The blood' means the life poured out -- that is why it atones.

body.ancient: The body -- and the church as Christ's body.
body.drift: Your body is not a shell; it is a temple, and it will be raised.

book.ancient: A scroll; a papyrus roll -- 'biblion' is the root of 'Bible.'
book.drift: God's word came on scrolls, meant to be unrolled and read aloud.

born.ancient: Born from above -- anothen means 'from above,' not just 'again.'
born.drift: 'Born again' is a heavenly birth, not a repeat performance.

bow.ancient: A bow for shooting -- and the rainbow.
bow.drift: God hung his war-bow in the sky as a promise: the rainbow is a weapon laid down.

branch.ancient: A sprout, a shoot from a stump.
branch.drift: The Messiah is the Branch -- life springing from a cut-down tree.

bread.ancient: Bread -- food, sustenance, everything you need to live.
bread.drift: 'Daily bread' means all of life's necessities, not just loaves.

bride.drift: The church is Christ's bride -- the Bible ends with a wedding.

bronze.ancient: Copper or bronze -- the metal of judgment in the tabernacle.
bronze.drift: Bronze altar, bronze serpent: judgment made visible.

brother.ancient: From the same womb -- church family.
brother.drift: Not just a friendly title; believers are blood family in Christ.

buy.drift: 'You were bought with a price' -- marketplace language for redemption.

caesar.ancient: The Roman emperor -- whose face was stamped on the coin.
caesar.drift: 'Render to Caesar': the coin bears his image; you bear God's -- give yourself to God.

call.drift: God's call is a summons you cannot unhear.

called.drift: Every believer is 'called': invited on purpose, not an accident.

cast.ancient: To throw out, drive out -- forceful.
cast.drift: Jesus didn't politely ask demons to leave; he threw them out.

celebrate.ancient: To rejoice, be glad -- festival joy.
celebrate.drift: Celebration is commanded: rejoice before the LORD your God.

chaff.ancient: Chaff -- the husks the wind blows away.
chaff.drift: The wicked are chaff (Ps 1): weightless, rootless, gone with the wind.

chain.ancient: A fetter -- what holds a prisoner.
chain.drift: Paul the prisoner of Christ: chains for the gospel are honor, not shame.

change.ancient: To change, alter -- to be different.
change.drift: God does not change (Mal 3:6): his changelessness is our anchor.

charge.drift: A charge is a command with weight: keep it.

chariot.ancient: A war chariot -- the tank of the ancient world.
chariot.drift: Some trust in chariots... but we trust in the name of the LORD (Ps 20:7).

charity.ancient: Love -- the KJV word for agape love.
charity.drift: Not donations; it is selfless, committed love.

chasten.ancient: To train a child -- discipline as upbringing.
chasten.drift: Child-training, not criminal punishment: God disciplines sons, not strangers.

cheerful.drift: God loves a cheerful giver (2 Cor 9:7): joy is the acceptable currency.

cherubim.ancient: Mighty angelic guardians (plural; one is a cherub) -- stationed at Eden's gate and over the ark.
cherubim.drift: Not babies with bows; throne-room guardians with wings and swords.

chief.drift: Christ is the head: the chief cornerstone and the head of the church.

child.drift: Unless you become like a child: smallness is the entrance requirement.

children.drift: Children are a heritage of the LORD (Ps 127): not burdens, but gifts.

choose.drift: You did not choose me, but I chose you (John 15:16): chosen before choosing.

chosen.drift: Not about being better -- it is about being chosen for a job.

christ.ancient: Anointed one -- the Greek of Hebrew 'Messiah.'
christ.drift: 'Christ' is not Jesus's last name; it is his title: the Anointed King.

church.ancient: The called-out assembly -- a gathered people.
church.drift: Not a building, a steeple, or a service. You cannot 'go to' church in the Bible's sense -- you ARE the church.

circumcision.ancient: A cutting around -- the sign of the covenant.
circumcision.drift: Paul says the real one is 'of the heart' -- the sign points inward.

city.ancient: A walled city -- safety, people, life together.
city.drift: The Bible ends with a city, not an escape: the New Jerusalem coming down.

clay.drift: You are the clay, God the potter -- the clay doesn't argue with the wheel.

clean.ancient: Clean, pure -- fit for God's presence.
clean.drift: More than hygiene: cleanness is about being fit to approach God.

cleanse.drift: Only God can cleanse the inside; soap handles the outside.

cloud.ancient: A cloud -- God's chariot (Ps 104:3), his glory's vehicle.
cloud.drift: From Sinai to the ascension, God rides clouds.

comfort.ancient: To breathe deeply, sigh -- comfort as a deep breath with you.
comfort.drift: Comfort in the Bible is God sighing with you, not just cheering you up.

commandment.ancient: A command, a charge -- something appointed to do.
commandment.drift: Not suggestions from a committee; orders from the King who loves you.

communion.drift: Deeper than a cracker and a cup -- it is shared life.

compassion.ancient: The inner organs; womb-love -- compassion felt in the gut.
compassion.drift: Compassion is motherly: the same root as 'womb.' God feels mercy like a mother.

condemn.drift: 'No condemnation' (Rom 8:1) is the gospel in two words.

confess.ancient: To say the same thing -- to agree.
confess.drift: To confess sin is to agree with God about it: call it what he calls it.

cornerstone.ancient: The corner stone -- the key block that squares the building.
cornerstone.drift: 'The stone the builders rejected' (Ps 118) becomes the cornerstone: Jesus.

counsel.drift: God's counsel stands forever; man's counsel needs a backup plan.

covenant.ancient: A binding, blood-sealed agreement between two parties.
covenant.drift: Stronger than a promise or contract -- it is family-level commitment.

cover.ancient: To cover, conceal -- sin covered by blood.
cover.drift: Blessed is he whose sin is COVERED (Ps 32:1).

covet.ancient: To desire strongly -- to crave what is not yours.
covet.drift: The tenth commandment aims at the heart: wanting is where stealing starts.

create.ancient: To shape, fashion -- used in the Bible of divine activity.
create.drift: Only God 'bara's in the Bible. Creating is his signature move.

cross.ancient: An upright stake or pole -- Rome's execution device.
cross.drift: The most shameful death imaginable, turned into the symbol of victory.

crown.ancient: A victor's wreath -- the athlete's prize, not (here) the king's crown.
crown.drift: It is about finishing the race, not inheriting a throne.

crucify.ancient: To stake, to execute on a cross.
crucify.drift: The slowest, most public, most shameful Roman death.

cry.ancient: To cry out -- the scream that God always answers.
cry.drift: Israel cried out and God heard: the cry is prayer in its rawest form.

curse.ancient: To make light of, treat as trifling -- the opposite of blessing.
curse.drift: Cursing makes light of what God made weighty.

dance.drift: David danced before the ark -- worship with your whole body.

darkness.ancient: Darkness -- the absence of light, a picture of evil and chaos.
darkness.drift: But God is not afraid of the dark: 'even the darkness is not dark to you.'

daughter.ancient: A daughter -- and 'daughters of' can mean the women of a place.
daughter.drift: 'Daughters of Jerusalem,' 'daughters of Zion' -- the city's womenfolk.

day.ancient: A day -- and also a period of time.
day.drift: 'The day of the LORD' is not 24 hours; it is God's appointed time of action.

deacon.ancient: A servant, a waiter -- one who serves tables.
deacon.drift: Not a board member; the word is table-waiter.

death.ancient: Death -- the end of this life.
death.drift: The Bible calls death an enemy (1 Cor 15:26) -- and a defeated one.

debt.ancient: What is owed -- and the Lord's Prayer's word for sin.
debt.drift: Sin pictured as money owed: 'forgive us our debts.'

deceit.drift: Deceit's word-picture is a fishhook -- it catches you.

declare.drift: Declaring is not discussing; it is announcing.

dedicate.ancient: To train, initiate, set apart for a purpose.
dedicate.drift: Hanukkah means 'dedication' -- and Proverbs 22:6 uses the same word for training a child.

deliver.drift: Rescue language -- God snatches; he doesn't just advise.

demon.ancient: An evil spirit, a fallen messenger.
demon.drift: Real, hostile, and defeated -- never to be feared by those in Christ.

deny.drift: Peter denied Jesus; Jesus warns against denying him -- disowning works both ways.

dew.drift: Dew pictures grace: silent, gentle, life-giving. No thunder, just refreshment.

discern.drift: Discernment sifts like wheat -- separating grain from chaff.

disciple.ancient: A learner, apprentice, follower -- one who learns by walking with the teacher.
disciple.drift: Not a graduate; a trainee. Discipleship is apprenticeship.

discipline.drift: Discipline is child-training -- about raising kids, not punishing criminals.

divorce.ancient: A standing away -- a certificate of separation.
divorce.drift: Divorce is pictured as distance: two people standing apart.

dominion.drift: Humans are God's vice-regents: ruling creation under him, not over him.

door.ancient: A door, a gate, an entrance.
door.drift: 'I am the door' (John 10) -- the only entrance to the sheepfold.

dove.ancient: A dove, a pigeon -- the poor person's sacrifice.
dove.drift: The Spirit descends 'like a dove' -- gentle, not like an eagle.

draw.drift: 'Draw near to God and he will draw near to you' -- closeness is a promise.

dream.ancient: A dream -- one of God's megaphones.
dream.drift: From Joseph to Daniel to Joseph: God talks in dreams to those who listen.

dust.drift: 'Dust you are' -- humans are earth that God breathed into.

dwell.ancient: To settle, tabernacle -- to pitch your tent and stay.
dwell.drift: God 'tabernacled' among us (John 1:14) -- he moved into the neighborhood.

eagle.ancient: Probably the bearded vulture or griffon -- a huge soaring bird.
eagle.drift: Not the American bald eagle; a desert glider that rides the wind.

earth.ancient: Land, earth, ground -- the place under your feet.
earth.drift: 'The earth is the LORD's' -- it is leased to us, not owned by us.

earthquake.drift: When God shows up, the ground notices: Sinai, the cross, the resurrection.

edify.drift: Edification is construction: are your words building or bulldozing?

egypt.drift: The Bible's picture of bondage: every 'Egypt' is a place God brings you OUT of.

elder.ancient: An older one -- a leader of the local church.
elder.drift: A shepherd's title, not a CEO's: age, wisdom, and care.

elect.drift: Chosen for a job, not chosen for being better.

encourage.ancient: To call alongside -- comfort, urge, cheer on.
encourage.drift: Encouragement is coming alongside, not shouting from the stands.

endure.ancient: To remain under the load; to bear up.
endure.drift: Not passive waiting -- staying kind and faithful while suffering.

enemy.drift: 'Love your enemies' -- the hardest command has the clearest object.

envy.drift: Envy rots the bones (Prov 14:30) -- the only sin with no pleasure in it.

eternal.ancient: Of the age to come; age-long.
eternal.drift: More about KIND of life than LENGTH: the life of the coming age, starting now.

everlasting.ancient: Long duration -- distant time, beyond the horizon.
everlasting.drift: 'From everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.' Time runs out; he doesn't.

evil.drift: Evil is real but not ultimate: it is a parasite on good, not its equal.

exalt.drift: God's pattern: humble yourself and he lifts you; exalt yourself and he lowers you.

exile.drift: God's people have been outsiders before -- exile is where faith gets refined.

eye.ancient: An eye -- and also a spring or fountain of water.
eye.drift: 'The eye is the lamp of the body': what you look at fills you.

face.drift: You never see just one 'face' of God; he is always more.

faith.ancient: Trust, firm confidence -- and faithfulness, loyalty.
faith.drift: Modern 'faith' often means blind belief; biblical faith is active trust, like trusting a bridge by walking on it.

faithful.drift: Faithfulness is shown in small things before big ones.

faithfulness.drift: God's faithfulness is the ground under every promise.

fall.drift: 'Let him who thinks he stands take heed lest he fall' -- pride precedes it.

famine.drift: Famines in the Bible always drive people somewhere: to Egypt, to Moab, to God.

fast.ancient: Abstaining from food -- to seek God urgently.
fast.drift: Not a diet; it is hunger turned into prayer.

father.ancient: Father -- source, protector, head of the household.
father.drift: 'Our Father' was revolutionary: the Almighty invites you to call him Dad.

fatherless.drift: God calls himself 'father of the fatherless': his special clients.

favor.ancient: Grace, charm, acceptance -- found, not earned.
favor.drift: Noah 'found favor' -- same word family as grace.

fear.ancient: Reverence, awe -- when it is of God; terror when it is of man.
fear.drift: 'Fear of the LORD' is awe, not terror -- like standing at the Grand Canyon.

feast.ancient: A pilgrimage feast -- a journey to celebrate.
feast.drift: Feasts were road trips: God's people traveled to rejoice together.

feed.ancient: To feed, graze -- a shepherd's first job.
feed.drift: 'Feed my sheep' (John 21): leadership is feeding, not ruling.

fellowship.drift: Not coffee and donuts after church; shared goods, shared suffering, shared life.

fire.ancient: Fire -- God's presence, judgment, and purifying.
fire.drift: Burning bush, Sinai, Pentecost: God shows up in fire.

firmament.ancient: An expanse -- a hammered-out sheet, like beaten metal.
firmament.drift: The KJV's famous word: the sky pictured as a vast dome overhead.

first.drift: 'Seek FIRST the kingdom' -- first place, not leftover place.

firstfruits.ancient: The first portion of the harvest.
firstfruits.drift: Give God the first, not the leftovers: firstfruits sanctify the whole harvest.

fish.ancient: A fish -- and the early church's secret symbol.
fish.drift: 'Ichthys' spells 'Jesus Christ, Son of God, Savior' in Greek initials.

flee.drift: Some things you fight; some you flee: 'flee youthful lusts.'

flesh.ancient: Meat, the body -- and human nature in its weakness.
flesh.drift: Not just skin: it is human life trying to run without God.

flood.ancient: The great deluge -- this word is used only of Noah's flood.
flood.drift: A one-of-a-kind word for a one-of-a-kind judgment.

flourishing.ancient: Luxuriant, fresh, green -- like a well-watered tree.
flourishing.drift: The righteous flourish like the palm tree (Ps 92:12).

follow.ancient: To walk the same road behind someone.
follow.drift: Discipleship is footsteps: you go where he goes.

fool.drift: The fool is not stupid; he is morally withered, saying 'no God' in his heart.

foreknow.drift: God's foreknowledge is personal -- he knew YOU, not just facts about you.

forgive.ancient: To send away, release -- to let it go.
forgive.drift: Forgiveness sends the debt away; it doesn't pretend there was none.

forgiveness.drift: The debt is released -- stamped 'paid' by another.

fornication.ancient: Sexual immorality broadly -- any sex outside marriage.

fortress.ancient: A stronghold, a fortified high place.
fortress.drift: David's favorite picture of God: a hiding place, not a lecture hall.

foundation.ancient: A foundation -- what everything stands on.
foundation.drift: 'No other foundation but Christ': everything is built on him or on sand.

friend.ancient: A companion, a loved one -- covenant friendship.
friend.drift: 'A friend loves at all times' -- rea is loyalty, not convenience.

frost.drift: 'He gives snow like wool' -- even frost is God's handiwork (Ps 147).

fruit.drift: 'Fruit of the Spirit': fruit GROWS; you don't manufacture it.

fruitful.drift: God's first command to humans: be fruitful. Fruitfulness is the plan, not the exception.

fulfill.drift: Jesus 'fulfilled' the law the way a cup fulfills its purpose: filled to the brim.

fullness.ancient: The full measure -- everything filled to the brim.
fullness.drift: 'Of his fullness we have all received': there is always more of Christ.

garment.ancient: Clothing -- and often a symbol of status or righteousness.
garment.drift: From Adam's skins to the robe of righteousness: God clothes his people.

gate.ancient: The city gate -- the place of business, news, and justice.
gate.drift: Gates were courthouses and markets. 'The gates of hell' means Satan's council.

gentile.ancient: The nations -- peoples who are not Israel.
gentile.drift: Just means non-Jewish peoples; the gospel was always meant for them too.

ghost.ancient: Spirit -- the KJV's word for the Holy Spirit.
ghost.drift: 'Holy Ghost' is 1600s English for Holy Spirit. Not a spook!

gift.ancient: A grace-gift -- grace with a bow on it.
gift.drift: Every gift is grace: unearned, given, meant to be given away.

gird.ancient: To wrap, equip -- tucking up the robe to run or work.
gird.drift: 'Gird up your loins': get ready, get moving.

glorify.drift: We glorify God the way a mirror glorifies the sun: by reflecting.

glory.ancient: Weight, heaviness -- honor, splendor; God's real, heavy presence.
glory.drift: English 'glory' sounds like mere brightness; the Hebrew means WEIGHT. Glory is God being undeniably there.

god.ancient: Strength, mighty one -- 'Elohim' is plural in form with singular verbs.
god.drift: The plural 'Elohim' doing singular actions: the Bible's first hint that God is more than simple.

gold.ancient: Gold -- the metal of kingship and glory.
gold.drift: Streets of gold in Revelation: what we hoard, heaven paves with.

goodness.ancient: Good, pleasant, beautiful -- God's verdict on creation.
goodness.drift: 'God saw that it was good': goodness is the original state of things.

gospel.ancient: Good news -- a royal announcement of victory.
gospel.drift: Rome used the word for the emperor's victories; the Bible hijacks it for Jesus.

grace.ancient: Unmerited favor -- kindness shown to someone who has not earned it. A gift.
grace.drift: Sometimes reduced to 'a prayer before meals' or mere elegance; in the Bible it is God's free, rescuing kindness.

grave.drift: 'O grave, where is thy victory?' -- mocked by the resurrection.

greed.ancient: The desire for more -- always more.
greed.drift: Greed is idolatry with a calculator (Col 3:5).

groan.drift: The Spirit intercedes 'with groanings' (Rom 8): when you can't pray, he groans for you.

grow.drift: Growth is God's job description for living things -- including you.

guide.ancient: To lead, bring along the way.
guide.drift: 'He leads me beside still waters': guidance is personal, not a map.

guile.drift: Deceit's word-picture is a fishhook: it catches you.

hail.ancient: Hail -- ice from the sky, one of God's arsenals.
hail.drift: Hailstones as weapons: God fights with weather (Josh 10).

hallelujah.ancient: 'Praise Yah!' -- halal (praise) plus Yah, short for Yahuah.
hallelujah.drift: The Bible's own cheer: it commands praise in God's personal name.

hand.ancient: The hand -- and the picture of power and authority.
hand.drift: God's 'hand' does the saving: the exodus, the cross, your life.

harp.drift: David's instrument: not a concert harp, a shepherd's lyre.

harvest.ancient: The harvest -- gathering what was sown.
harvest.drift: Harvest is judgment-and-joy language: the end of the age in farming clothes.

hate.ancient: To hate -- and in Semitic idiom, 'love less.'
hate.drift: 'Jacob I loved, Esau I hated': covenant preference language, not spite.

heal.ancient: To mend, cure -- to make whole.
heal.drift: God introduces himself as 'the LORD who heals you' (Ex 15:26).

hear.ancient: To hear -- and in Hebrew, hearing IS obeying.
hear.drift: There is no separate word: to hear and not do is to not hear.

heart.ancient: The seat of thought, will, and choice.
heart.drift: The Bible's 'heart' thinks and decides -- it is not just the feelings department.

heaven.ancient: The sky -- and God's dwelling place, his throne room.
heaven.drift: Not just 'up there': it is the control room of reality, breaking into earth.

hebrew.ancient: One from beyond (the river) -- Abraham the crosser-over.
hebrew.drift: God's people have always been outsiders: 'Hebrew' means foreigner.

heed.ancient: To prick up the ears, listen sharply.
heed.drift: Heeding is active hearing: ears up, like a dog at a sound.

hell.ancient: Three different words hide under one English word: SHEOL (Hebrew) -- the grave, the shadowy realm of all the dead; HADES (Greek) -- the same; GEHENNA -- the Valley of Hinnom, Jerusalem's burning trash dump, Jesus's picture of final judgment.
hell.drift: Readers hear one word, but Jesus mostly says 'Gehenna' -- a real valley with real fire.
hell.origin: Hebrew sheol / Greek hades / Greek gehenna

helper.ancient: One called alongside to help -- a defense attorney, an advocate.
helper.drift: The Spirit is your Helper: heaven's lawyer, assigned to your case.

herald.ancient: A town crier -- one who proclaims officially.
herald.drift: Preaching is heralding: announcing the King's decree, not suggesting ideas.

hiding.drift: 'He who dwells in the secret place' -- God is the best hiding spot.

holy.ancient: Set apart, sacred, dedicated -- reserved for a special purpose.
holy.drift: Not 'super good' or boring: it means belonging to God, off-limits to the ordinary.

honey.drift: 'A land flowing with milk and honey': abundance you don't have to work for.

honor.ancient: To be heavy -- the same root as 'glory' (kabod).
honor.drift: To honor is to treat as WEIGHTY. Honor and glory share a root.

hope.ancient: Confident expectation -- certainty about what is coming.
hope.drift: Not wishful thinking ('I hope so'); it is assurance with a future date.

hosanna.ancient: 'Save now, please!' -- a cry for rescue.
hosanna.drift: The crowd's shout at Jesus's entry: a prayer, not just a cheer.

household.ancient: House, household, family -- the whole clan under one roof.
household.drift: Your 'house' was your people: 'as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.'

humble.ancient: Lowly -- not thinking too highly of yourself.
humble.drift: Humility is not thinking less of yourself; it is thinking of yourself less.

humility.drift: The mind of Christ (Phil 2): humility is a mindset before it is an act.

husband.drift: Hebrew and Greek use one word for 'man/husband' and 'woman/wife': marriage makes the words overlap.

hymn.ancient: A song of praise to God.
hymn.drift: Paul and Silas sang hymns in prison at midnight: praise needs no permission.

hypocrite.ancient: A stage actor -- one who plays a part, wearing a mask.
hypocrite.drift: Greek theater word: religion as performance.

image.ancient: A likeness, a representation -- like a statue of a king in his territory.
image.drift: You are God's statue in his world: placed to represent the King.

immanuel.drift: The name is the promise: he didn't stay distant.

incense.drift: 'Let my prayer be set before you as incense' (Ps 141): worship you can smell.

inheritance.ancient: A family's allotted portion -- what heirs receive.
inheritance.drift: 'The LORD is my portion': he is the inheritance.

iniquity.drift: Stronger than a mistake: iniquity is bent out of shape inside.

intercede.ancient: To meet, to strike upon -- throwing yourself between.
intercede.drift: Moses interceded for Israel: one person standing in the gap.

iron.ancient: Iron -- the metal of strength and war.

israel.ancient: 'He strives with God' -- the name earned in a wrestling match (Gen 32).
israel.drift: Fitting name for God's people ever since: they wrestle with him and cling.

jealous.ancient: Zealous, protective -- of God, a husband's fierce love.
jealous.drift: God's jealousy is not insecurity; it is a husband defending his bride.

jehovah.ancient: YHWH written with the vowels of 'Adonai' -- a hybrid form coined in the Middle Ages.
jehovah.drift: No ancient Hebrew ever said 'Jehovah': it was built by combining two words.

jesus.drift: His name IS his mission: the Savior's name announces the saving.

jew.ancient: One from Judah -- a member of the tribe and kingdom.
jew.drift: From a tribe name to a people name: identity that survived exile.

joy.ancient: Gladness, delight -- deep, not just cheerful.
joy.drift: 'The joy of the LORD is your strength': joy is fuel, not frosting.

jubilee.ancient: A ram's horn -- and the 50th year it announced: debts canceled, slaves freed, land returned.
jubilee.drift: Every 50 years, God hit the reset button on the economy.

judge.ancient: To govern, vindicate, rescue -- not just condemn.
judge.drift: In Judges, 'judging' meant SAVING Israel. Judgment can be rescue.

judgment.ancient: A separating, a decision -- justice rendered.
judgment.drift: A courtroom word: separating right from wrong, sheep from goats.

just.drift: Justice is straightness: no bends, no bribes.

justification.drift: A courtroom word: the Judge bangs the gavel -- 'not guilty.'

justify.drift: God justifies the ungodly (Rom 4:5): the verdict precedes the behavior.

keep.ancient: To guard, watch over -- like a shepherd with sheep.
keep.drift: 'Keep my commands' means guard them like treasure.

kidneys.ancient: The kidneys -- the seat of deepest emotions in Hebrew thought.
kidneys.drift: KJV's 'reins': Hebrews felt feelings in the kidneys, not the heart!

kind.ancient: Good, kind, pleasant -- and it sounded like 'Christos' to Greek ears.
kind.drift: Early Christians loved the pun: Christ is 'kind' -- easy to follow, good to know.

kindness.drift: 'Kindness leads to repentance' (Rom 2:4): God's kindness is an evangelist.

king.drift: Israel's kings were judged by one standard: did they follow the LORD?

kingdom.ancient: Reign, rule, kingship -- as much about WHO rules as WHERE.
kingdom.drift: God's kingdom is wherever he calls the shots -- including your heart, today.

kinsman.ancient: A near relative who buys back -- the family redeemer.
kinsman.drift: Boaz the kinsman-redeemer is a living parable: family that pays your debts. Jesus is ours.

know.ancient: To know by experience -- intimate, hands-on knowledge.
know.drift: Adam 'knew' Eve: it is relationship knowledge, not trivia.

knowledge.ancient: Knowledge -- what is known by experience.
knowledge.drift: 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge': it starts with awe.

lamb.ancient: A little lamb -- the Passover lamb, the suffering servant.
lamb.drift: John's favorite picture of Jesus: the Lamb who was slain, reigning.

lamp.ancient: An oil torch -- a flame in the dark.
lamp.drift: 'Thy word is a lamp': not a floodlight, a flame for the next step.

law.ancient: Instruction, teaching, guidance -- a father's directions for a good life.
law.drift: Not just rules and punishments; 'torah' is teaching, like a parent's wisdom.

leaven.ancient: Yeast -- a little spreads through the whole batch.
leaven.drift: Usually a picture of sin spreading quietly -- or of the kingdom (Matt 13:33)!

leper.ancient: A scaly skin disease -- a range of conditions that made one 'unclean.'
leper.drift: Not necessarily modern leprosy; the tragedy was exclusion, not just illness.

leviathan.ancient: A sea monster -- chaos creature of the deep.
leviathan.drift: God's pet monster, almost: he 'plays' with Leviathan (Ps 104:26).

liberty.ancient: Freedom -- for service, not for self.
liberty.drift: Biblical freedom is 'free to serve,' not 'free to please yourself.'

life.ancient: Life -- chayyim is plural! And zoe is full, abundant life (vs bios, mere existence).
life.drift: Jesus offers ZOE -- life to the full -- not just BIOS, getting by.

light.drift: 'God is light': no shadows, no hiding, no night shift.

lightning.drift: 'His lightning to the ends of the earth': even storms are his servants.

likeness.drift: Made in God's 'image and likeness': two words for one dignity.

linen.ancient: Linen -- clean, white cloth of priests and angels.
linen.drift: Fine linen is 'the righteous acts of the saints' (Rev 19:8).

lion.drift: Both Jesus (Lion of Judah) and Satan (roaring lion) -- check which lion!

lips.drift: God confused their 'lip' at Babel: one language, scattered.

living.drift: 'The living God' -- not a dead idol, but alive and acting.

longsuffering.ancient: Long-suffering -- slow to anger, patient under provocation.
longsuffering.drift: KJV's beautiful word for makrothymia: suffering long without snapping.

loose.ancient: To untie, release -- rabbis used it for 'permit.'
loose.drift: 'Whatever you loose on earth': heaven's language for permitting.

lord.ancient: Master, owner -- the one in charge.
lord.drift: Polite church title today; in the Bible it is a claim of total ownership.

lost.ancient: Destroyed, perishing -- in danger, not just misplaced.
lost.drift: The lost coin and sheep aren't mislaid; they are perishing without rescue.

lot.ancient: A pebble cast -- how decisions were made.
lot.drift: Casting lots let God choose through the stones (Prov 16:33).

love.ancient: AGAPE: selfless, committed love -- love as a choice. PHILEO: brotherly affection, friendship.
love.drift: English has one word; the Bible has a toolbox. 'Do you agape me?' 'I phileo you' (John 21) is the most tender wordplay in Scripture.

lovingkindness.ancient: KJV's word for chesed -- tender, loyal, covenant love.
lovingkindness.drift: One English word trying to hold 'steadfast love, mercy, kindness, loyalty' at once.

lust.drift: Not always sexual: it is craving aimed wrong -- the desire itself is neutral until it aims.

mammon.ancient: Wealth personified -- money as a rival god.
mammon.drift: Jesus treats money like a master: you can only serve one.

man.ancient: A human being (anthropos) -- humanity, not just males.
man.drift: 'Son of Man' is anthropos: the Human One, not the Male One.

manna.ancient: 'What is it?' -- the question became the name.
manna.drift: Bread from heaven with an expiration date: gather daily, trust daily.

mantle.ancient: A cloak of distinction -- a prophet's outer garment.
mantle.drift: Elijah's mantle carried his calling; Elisha picked it up and the ministry continued.

maranatha.ancient: 'Our Lord, come!' -- Aramaic, the church's earliest prayer.
maranatha.drift: The Bible's last prayer in its first language: Come, Lord!

marriage.drift: The Bible opens with a wedding (Adam and Eve) and closes with one (Christ and the church).

martyr.drift: Witness and martyr are ONE word: testimony could cost your life.

master.ancient: An absolute ruler, a despot -- stronger than 'lord.'
master.drift: Used of God the Father and of slave-owners: total authority, no appeal.

mediator.ancient: A go-between -- one who stands in the middle.
mediator.drift: 'One mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus' -- no middlemen needed after him.

meditate.ancient: To mutter, growl -- like a lion over its prey.
meditate.drift: Not emptying your mind; it is chewing the word, mumbling it under your breath.

meek.ancient: Gentle strength -- power under control, like a tamed war horse.
meek.drift: Not weak or spineless: it is strength that chooses gentleness. 'The meek shall inherit the earth.'

memorial.ancient: A remembrance, a reminder set up.
memorial.drift: Memorials in the Bible are for ACTION: stones so the next generation asks, 'what do these mean?'

mercy.ancient: Steadfast, loyal love -- covenant kindness that won't let go; compassion.
mercy.drift: 'Mercy' sounds like a judge letting you off; chesed is love that keeps its promises.

mercyseat.ancient: The covering -- the golden lid of the ark where blood was sprinkled.
mercyseat.drift: God's throne of mercy: judgment covered by blood. Jesus IS the mercy seat (Rom 3:25).

messiah.drift: The Hebrew behind 'Christ': the one anointed with the Spirit without limit.

milk.drift: 'Milk for babes, meat for the mature': start simple, grow up.

mind.drift: 'Be transformed by the renewing of your mind': the battlefield is between the ears.

minister.ancient: A servant, a waiter -- one who serves tables.
minister.drift: Not a title or rank; it is the table-waiter word. Ministry is serving.

miracle.ancient: A sign; a mighty work, a power.
miracle.drift: The Bible calls them 'signs' -- they point somewhere. Don't stare at the finger; follow where it points.

mite.ancient: The smallest coin -- the widow's offering.
mite.drift: The tiniest coin, and Jesus called it the biggest gift (Mark 12).

mock.drift: They mocked Jesus on the cross; he prayed for them mid-mock.

morning.drift: 'Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.'

mother.drift: God comforts 'as a mother comforts' (Isa 66): tenderness is divine.

mountain.drift: God meets people on mountains: Sinai, Carmel, Olivet. Go up to meet him.

mouth.ancient: The mouth -- and what comes out of it.
mouth.drift: 'Out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks': the mouth leaks the heart.

multiply.drift: God's blessing word: multiply -- life spreading life.

murder.drift: KJV's 'Thou shalt not KILL' is ratsach: MURDER. The command is about murder, not all killing.

mystery.ancient: A secret now revealed -- not a puzzle, a disclosed secret.
mystery.drift: 'The mystery of Christ': hidden for ages, now told openly.

naked.drift: Adam and Eve were naked and unashamed: innocence needs no cover.

name.drift: More than a label: to act 'in someone's name' is to carry their full weight.

nation.drift: 'Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD' -- nations are judged too.

new.ancient: Fresh, new in KIND -- not just new in time.
new.drift: 'New covenant,' 'new creation': kainos means brand-new kind, not renovated.

night.ancient: Night -- darkness, and God's watch hours.
night.drift: Hebrew days start at evening: darkness first, then light. Grace pattern!

oath.drift: God swore by himself (no higher authority): his oath is unbreakable.

obedience.drift: Obedience is just hearing, fully done.

obey.drift: In Hebrew, hearing IS obeying: there is no separate word. To hear and not do is to not hear.

offering.ancient: A gift, a tribute -- like a king's tribute.
offering.drift: Offerings are loyalty gifts: what you bring shows who you serve.

oil.ancient: Olive oil -- for light, healing, and anointing.
oil.drift: The Spirit's favorite symbol: oil for lamps, wounds, and kings.

old.drift: 'Gray hair is a crown of glory' (Prov 16:31): age meant honor.

one.ancient: One -- and it can mean a compound unity.
one.drift: 'The LORD is one' uses the same word as 'one flesh': unity, not solitude.

overcome.drift: 'Overcomers' in Revelation are conquerors: winners, not mere survivors.

parable.drift: Stories that reveal truth to the hungry and hide it from the hard-hearted.

paradise.ancient: A walled garden -- a Persian word for a king's park.
paradise.drift: Jesus's word to the thief on the cross: 'today... paradise.'

partake.drift: Communion is partaking: sharing in Christ himself, not just remembering.

passover.drift: The blood on the door: judgment passes over the marked house.

pastor.ancient: A shepherd -- one who feeds, guides, and guards.
pastor.drift: 'Pastor' is just Latin for shepherd: the job is feeding sheep, not running a business.

patience.ancient: Long-suffering -- slow to anger, patient under provocation.
patience.drift: Not passive waiting; it is staying kind while suffering.

peace.ancient: Wholeness, completeness, well-being -- everything working as it should.
peace.drift: Not just the absence of fighting: shalom is everything fixed, full, and flourishing.

peculiar.drift: KJV's 'peculiar people' doesn't mean weird; it means specially POSSESSED by God.

penny.ancient: A day's wage -- the standard pay for a laborer.
penny.drift: The 'penny' in the parables is a full day's pay: feel the generosity.

perfect.drift: Not flawless: it is grown-up, whole, complete.

persevere.ancient: Remaining under -- staying put under the load.
persevere.drift: Perseverance is not gritting teeth; it is remaining under God's hand.

pestilence.drift: One of God's judgments -- and one of the horsemen's companions.

pharisee.ancient: A separated one -- the strict, separated party.
pharisee.drift: Separated FOR holiness, but often separated FROM people.

physician.drift: Luke was one: the gospel writer with a healer's eye for detail.

pillar.drift: 'Pillar of cloud, pillar of fire': God himself was Israel's pillar.

plague.drift: The plagues were blows against Egypt's gods, one by one.

poor.ancient: A beggar, destitute -- the humble afflicted.
poor.drift: God's special concern: the Bible mentions the poor over 2,000 times.

portion.drift: 'The LORD is my portion': he is the inheritance.

possession.ancient: A holding, property -- land held permanently.
possession.drift: Canaan as an 'everlasting possession': God's land grant.

potter.drift: You are the clay, God the potter: the clay doesn't argue with the wheel.

power.ancient: Ability, explosive power -- where 'dynamite' comes from.
power.drift: 'You shall receive power': not human energy, but dynamite from on high.

praise.ancient: To boast, shine, celebrate loudly -- bragging on God.
praise.drift: Not quiet, polite clapping: praise is boasting about God.

pray.drift: Prayer is asking: bold, specific, persistent.

prayer.ancient: A pleading, an asking -- conversation with God.
prayer.drift: Conversation, not ceremony: talk, listen, repeat.

preach.ancient: To herald, proclaim as a town crier.
preach.drift: Preaching is announcing the King's decree, not suggesting ideas.

precept.drift: Psalm 119's word: precepts are marching orders, loved not resented.

predestine.ancient: To mark out beforehand -- staked out in advance.
predestine.drift: Like staking a claim: God marked his people before they existed.

priest.ancient: One who stands between God and people, offering sacrifices.
priest.drift: Every believer is now a priest (1 Pet 2:9): no middlemen needed.

priesthood.ancient: The office and people of priests.
priesthood.drift: 'A royal priesthood': the whole church is the priesthood now.

prince.drift: 'Prince of Peace': the ruler whose weapon is reconciliation.

prison.drift: Paul wrote half the New Testament from prison: chains never chained the gospel.

proclaim.drift: A herald's cry, not a lecture: proclamation is meant to be heard.

promise.ancient: An announcement of good -- God declaring what he will do.
promise.drift: God's promises are announcements: he declares, then delivers.

prophecy.ancient: A prophet's message -- forth-telling God's word.
prophecy.drift: Mostly forth-telling (speaking for God now), sometimes foretelling.

prophesy.ancient: To speak as a spokesman for God.
prophesy.drift: The test of a prophet: did God really say it? (Deut 18).

prophet.ancient: A spokesman -- one who speaks for God.
prophet.drift: Not primarily a fortune-teller: a prophet speaks God's words to the moment.

propitiation.ancient: The mercy seat -- the place of atonement, the ark's golden lid.
propitiation.drift: Jesus IS the mercy seat (Rom 3:25): the place where blood meets mercy.

proverb.ancient: A comparison, a parable -- wisdom in a sentence.
proverb.drift: Proverbs are not promises; they are patterns: generally true, wisely applied.

prudent.ancient: Crafty, shrewd -- in the good sense.
prudent.drift: The serpent was 'prudent' too: shrewdness is a tool; wisdom aims it.

psalm.drift: The Bible's hymnbook: meant to be sung, not just read.

publican.ancient: A tax-farmer -- one who bought the right to collect Rome's taxes.
publican.drift: Hated as a traitor and thief; Jesus ate with them anyway.

pure.drift: 'Blessed are the pure in heart': unmixed motives, seeing God.

purple.ancient: Purple dye -- worth more than gold.
purple.drift: Lydia sold it; Jesus wore it in mockery: the color of kings on the true King.

quench.drift: 'Do not quench the Spirit': don't pour water on God's fire.

quick.ancient: Living, alive -- 'the quick and the dead.'
quick.drift: KJV's 'quick' means alive: 'the living and the dead.'

quiet.drift: 'Study to be quiet': ambition aimed at peace, not noise.

rainbow.ancient: A war-bow hung in the sky.
rainbow.drift: God's bow pointed AWAY from earth: a weapon turned into a promise.

ransom.ancient: The price paid to free a captive or slave.
ransom.drift: Jesus 'gave his life a ransom': the purchase price of freedom.

rebuke.drift: Jesus rebuked winds, fevers, and demons: correction with authority.

receive.ancient: To take, grasp -- and to welcome.
receive.drift: 'As many as received him': taking hold of Christ like a lifeline.

reconcile.ancient: To change thoroughly -- to exchange enmity for friendship.
reconcile.drift: Reconciliation is exchange: enemies traded for friends.

redeem.ancient: To buy back -- to pay the price and set free.
redeem.drift: Marketplace language: God bought us back off the slave block.

redeemer.ancient: The kinsman who buys back -- the family member who pays your debts.
redeemer.drift: Boaz is the picture; Jesus is the reality.

redemption.ancient: A buying back, a release by payment.
redemption.drift: We were bought, not borrowed: the price was blood.

refuge.drift: God is the refuge: run TO him, not from him.

reign.drift: 'Death reigned... grace reigns': two kings, one throne -- choose.

rejoice.drift: Commanded, not suggested: 'Rejoice in the Lord ALWAYS.'

remember.ancient: To recall -- and to ACT on what you recall.
remember.drift: God 'remembering' means he acts: remembrance moves his hand.

remission.drift: 'Without shedding of blood there is no remission': release costs blood.

remnant.ancient: What is left over -- the survivors.
remnant.drift: God always keeps a remnant: his work never depends on the majority.

repent.ancient: A change of mind that turns your life around -- literally 'think differently afterward.'
repent.drift: Not just feeling sorry or crying; it is a U-turn of the whole person.

repentance.ancient: A change of mind, a turning.
repentance.drift: John's and Jesus's first sermon topic: 'Repent!' -- turn around.

rest.ancient: A ceasing from labor -- Sabbath rest, God's own rest.
rest.drift: Not a nap: it is entering God's finished work. Stop striving.

restoration.drift: The prophets' promise: what was lost will be brought back.

restore.ancient: To turn back, bring back -- repair.
restore.drift: 'Restore to me the joy of thy salvation': God un-breaks things.

resurrection.drift: Not a ghost or a memory: a BODY, standing up.

reveal.ancient: To uncover, unveil -- taking the lid off.
reveal.drift: Revelation is unveiling: God pulls back the curtain.

revelation.drift: The last book is 'The Unveiling': God showing what is really going on.

revive.ancient: To live again, to bring back to life.
revive.drift: 'Wilt thou not revive us again?': the church's oldest prayer.

reward.ancient: Wages, pay -- what is owed for work.
reward.drift: God pays wages for faithfulness: 'your labor is not in vain.'

riches.ancient: Wealth -- riches of grace, of glory.
riches.drift: Paul's favorite: the 'riches' of God, not of bank accounts.

righteous.ancient: In right standing -- declared and lived as right before God.
righteous.drift: Not 'self-righteous' or sinless perfection: it is being in the right with God, by faith and by life.

righteousness.ancient: Right standing with God -- justice, doing what is right.
righteousness.drift: 'The gift of righteousness': received, not achieved.

river.ancient: A river, a stream -- life in a dry land.
river.drift: 'A river whose streams make glad the city of God': life flowing from the throne.

robe.ancient: A long outer garment -- honor, status.
robe.drift: The prodigal got a robe: restored to sonship, not servanthood.

rock.ancient: A cliff, a crag -- unmovable stone.
rock.drift: 'The LORD is my rock': when everything shifts, he doesn't.

rod.ancient: A staff, a stick -- for guiding sheep and correcting children.
rod.drift: 'Thy rod and thy staff': guidance AND correction, both comfort.

sabbath.ancient: Rest, ceasing -- the seventh day of rest.
sabbath.drift: Not a burden day: a gift day. God rested; so can you.

sackcloth.ancient: Coarse goat-hair cloth -- the outfit of mourning and repentance.
sackcloth.drift: Wearing your grief: sackcloth said 'I am undone' without words.

sacrifice.ancient: An offering -- something precious given up.
sacrifice.drift: From Abel's lamb to Christ's cross: sacrifice is love's currency.

sadducee.ancient: A member of the priestly aristocratic party -- they denied the resurrection.
sadducee.drift: The liberals of their day: no angels, no spirits, no resurrection.

saint.ancient: A holy one -- someone set apart for God.
saint.drift: Not a dead hero with a halo: every believer is called a saint.

salt.drift: 'You are the salt of the earth': stop decay, add flavor.

salvation.drift: Bigger than 'going to heaven': rescue, healing, and wholeness, now and forever.

sanctify.ancient: To set apart as holy -- to dedicate to God.
sanctify.drift: Not 'make boring': it is reserving something for God's special use.

sanctuary.ancient: A holy place -- set apart for God's presence.
sanctuary.drift: From tabernacle to temple to YOU: 'your body is the temple.'

satisfy.drift: 'He satisfies the longing soul': only God fills the God-shaped hollow.

savior.drift: Title of emperors and gods in the ancient world; the Bible gives it to Jesus.

scapegoat.ancient: The goat 'for Azazel' -- sent away carrying the people's sins.
scapegoat.drift: One goat sacrificed, one sent away: forgiven AND forgotten.

scorner.drift: The progression of Psalm 1: walk, stand, SIT with scorners -- don't settle there.

scribe.ancient: A writer, a scholar of the law.
scribe.drift: The Bible scholars of their day -- and Jesus's frequent debate partners.

sea.ancient: The sea -- chaos, danger, the unknown deep.
sea.drift: 'No more sea' in Revelation: no more chaos, no more danger.

seal.ancient: A stamp of ownership and authenticity.
seal.drift: The Spirit is God's seal on you: owned, authentic, secure.

seed.drift: 'The seed of the woman' (Gen 3:15): the first promise of Jesus.

seek.ancient: To seek, search for -- with effort.
seek.drift: 'Seek and you will find': seeking is not wishing; it is hunting.

selah.ancient: Probably 'pause and reflect' -- a musical interlude.
selah.drift: The Bible's own 'take a breath': stop and think about what you just sang.

send.ancient: To send with a commission -- apostles are 'sent ones.'
send.drift: Sent-ness is the church's DNA: every believer is sent somewhere.

serpent.drift: From Eden's deceiver to the bronze serpent lifted up: the symbol gets redeemed at the cross.

servant.ancient: A slave, a bondservant -- one fully owned by a master.
servant.drift: Paul's proudest title: 'servant of Jesus Christ.' Owned, and glad of it.

serve.ancient: To serve as a slave serves -- total, not part-time.
serve.drift: 'Serve the LORD with gladness': slavery redefined as joy.

sheep.drift: The Bible's favorite self-portrait of us: needy, wandering, beloved.

shepherd.ancient: One who feeds, guides, and guards the flock.
shepherd.drift: 'The LORD is my shepherd': fed, led, and protected.

shield.drift: 'His truth shall be thy shield': faith blocks the flaming arrows.

shine.drift: 'Let your light shine': not to be seen, but so God is seen.

shoe.ancient: A sandal -- removed on holy ground.
shoe.drift: 'Take off your sandals': holy ground changes the footwear.

shout.ancient: A war cry -- the shout before battle.
shout.drift: Jericho fell to a shout: worship as a weapon.

sign.ancient: A sign, a mark -- pointing to something beyond itself.
sign.drift: Miracles are 'signs': don't stare at the finger, follow where it points.

silent.drift: 'Be still, and know': silence is where knowing happens.

sin.ancient: Missing the mark -- falling short of God's target.
sin.drift: An archer's word: the arrow didn't land where it should.

sing.drift: Commanded 250+ times in the Bible: singing is not optional equipment.

slave.ancient: A slave, a bondservant -- owned by a master.
slave.drift: 'Slaves of righteousness': everyone serves someone; choose your master.

sleep.ancient: Sleep -- and the Bible's gentle word for death.
sleep.drift: 'Those who sleep in Jesus': death as a nap before the morning.

smite.drift: KJV's word: 'smitten of God' -- struck. Isaiah 53's Servant was struck for us.

son.ancient: A son -- and 'son of' often means 'characterized by.'
son.drift: 'Sons of thunder,' 'son of perdition': sonship describes character.

soul.ancient: A living being -- the whole person, throat, life, self.
soul.drift: Not a ghost trapped in a body: 'soul' IS you -- the living, breathing person.

sow.drift: 'Whatever a man sows, that will he also reap': the farm law of life.

sower.drift: The sower sows everywhere -- even on the path: scatter generously.

spare.drift: 'He spared not his own Son': God held nothing back.

speak.ancient: To speak, to talk -- and God 'speaks' creation into being.
speak.drift: God's speech creates: 'Let there be' -- and there was.

spirit.ancient: Breath, wind -- God's breath, God's wind, God's Spirit.
spirit.drift: Same word for breath and Spirit: God's Spirit is his breath in you.

stagger.drift: Abraham 'staggered not': faith that doesn't wobble.

stand.ancient: To stand firm -- hold your ground.
stand.drift: 'Having done all, to stand': the victory posture.

star.ancient: A star -- and a symbol of angels and rulers.
star.drift: 'A star out of Jacob': the King announced by the sky.

stature.drift: Jesus 'increased in stature': growth is the plan.

steward.ancient: A household manager -- running the master's house.
steward.drift: You own nothing; you manage everything: stewardship is the job description.

stone.ancient: A stone -- for building, for memorials, for judgment.
stone.drift: The rejected stone became the cornerstone: God's building methods surprise.

straight.drift: Make straight the way of the Lord: straightness is preparation.

strait.drift: 'Strait is the gate': the way in is narrow on purpose.

strange.drift: 'Strange fire,' 'strange gods': foreign means forbidden here.

strength.drift: 'The joy of the LORD is your strength': joy is fuel.

stronghold.drift: 'Pulling down strongholds': arguments and pride, demolished by truth.

stumble.ancient: To trip -- and to cause to fall.
stumble.drift: 'Woe to the one who causes stumbling': tripping others is serious.

submit.ancient: To arrange under -- to line up beneath.
submit.drift: Military word: fall in line under God's order.

suffer.ancient: To undergo, endure -- to feel deeply.
suffer.drift: 'Christ suffered for us': suffering with a purpose -- yours.

supper.ancient: The evening meal -- the main meal of the day.
supper.drift: The Last Supper was a Passover: the old meal becoming the new.

sure.drift: 'Make your calling and election sure': certainty you can build on.

swear.drift: 'Swear not at all': let your yes be yes -- no oath needed.

sword.ancient: A sword -- and the word of God.
sword.drift: 'The sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God': the only offensive weapon listed.

tabernacle.ancient: A tent, a dwelling -- God's tent among his people.
tabernacle.drift: God pitched his tent with Israel; then 'the Word became flesh and tabernacled among us.'

table.ancient: A table -- for eating and for showing bread.
table.drift: 'Thou preparest a table before me': God feeds you in front of your enemies.

talent.drift: The 'talents' in the parable are fortunes: God entrusts big things.

tare.ancient: A weed that looks like wheat -- darnel.
tare.drift: Tares look like wheat until harvest: fakes are revealed at the end.

teach.ancient: To instruct, to disciple -- to train.
teach.drift: 'Teaching them to observe': the Great Commission is a teaching mission.

teacher.drift: 'You call me Teacher and Lord': the classroom has a King.

tears.drift: 'Put thou my tears into thy bottle': none of your crying is wasted.

temple.drift: From stone temple to living stones: YOU are the temple now.

tempt.ancient: To test, to try -- proving what is inside.
tempt.drift: God tests to prove; Satan tempts to destroy. Same fire, different purpose.

temptation.drift: 'God cannot be tempted, neither tempts he any man': testing proves, tempting traps.

ten.ancient: Ten -- the number of completeness in testimony.
ten.drift: Ten commandments, ten plagues: ten is the number of full witness.

tender.drift: God's mercies are 'tender': gentle hands, not rough ones.

testimony.drift: The ark held 'the testimony': God's evidence, carried with his people.

thankful.drift: Thankfulness is grace with its eyes open.

thanksgiving.drift: Enter his gates with thanksgiving: gratitude is the entrance fee.

theft.ancient: Stealing -- taking what is not yours.
theft.drift: 'Thou shalt not steal': property matters because people matter.

thief.drift: 'The thief comes to steal': Satan's job description in one line.

thirst.drift: 'Blessed are they which hunger and thirst': desperation is blessed.

thorn.ancient: A thorn -- pain, and a crown of them.
thorn.drift: Thorns first appear as curse (Gen 3); Jesus wears them as crown.

throne.ancient: A seat of power -- the king's chair.
throne.drift: 'Thy throne, O God, is forever': the one seat that never changes hands.

thyme.ancient: Not in the Bible as an herb -- see 'time.'
thyme.drift: If you meant the herb, the Bible doesn't name it; if you meant time, see 'time.'

tithe.ancient: A tenth -- the first tenth given to God.
tithe.drift: The training wheels of generosity: start with a tenth, learn to give.

tongue.ancient: The tongue -- and by extension, a language.
tongue.drift: 'The tongue is a fire': small, powerful, dangerous.

torment.drift: The word started as testing metal; it ended as pain.

transfigure.drift: Where 'metamorphosis' comes from: Jesus unveiled on the mountain.

treasure.ancient: A storehouse -- what is kept safe and valued.
treasure.drift: 'Where your treasure is, there will your heart be': follow the money to find the heart.

tree.ancient: A tree -- and the cross is called a 'tree.'
tree.drift: From Eden's tree to Calvary's tree to the tree of life: the story is bookended by trees.

trespass.ancient: A false step -- crossing the line.
trespass.drift: 'Forgive us our trespasses': sins as boundary crossings.

tribe.ancient: A staff -- each tribe under its staff of leadership.
tribe.drift: Twelve tribes, twelve staffs: God's people organized by family.

tribulation.drift: The word-picture is a winepress: pressure that produces.

trinity.ancient: Not a Bible word -- the church's shorthand for one God in three persons.
trinity.drift: The word isn't in the Bible; the reality is on every page.

trumpet.ancient: A ram's horn or metal trumpet -- alarm and announcement.
trumpet.drift: Trumpets announce: Sinai, Jericho, and the last day.

trust.ancient: To take refuge -- to run to shelter.
trust.drift: Trust is running: 'in thee, O LORD, do I put my trust' -- dive in.

truth.ancient: Firmness, reliability -- what holds up under weight.
truth.drift: Not just correct facts: emet is truth you can lean your full weight on.

turn.drift: 'Turn ye, turn ye': the Bible's shortest sermon.

twelve.ancient: Twelve -- the number of God's people.
twelve.drift: Twelve tribes, twelve apostles: God's people, numbered complete.

unbelief.drift: Unbelief is not doubt; it is refusal.

unclean.ancient: Not fit for worship -- ritually unfit.
unclean.drift: Not about hygiene: it is about fitness to approach a holy God.

understand.ancient: To separate, distinguish -- to get it.
understand.drift: Understanding separates: it divides truth from error.

understanding.ancient: Discernment -- the ability to separate and see.
understanding.drift: 'A man of understanding': one who can tell things apart.

unequal.drift: 'Unequally yoked': a picture of two oxen pulling different ways.

unite.drift: Jesus prayed 'that they may be one': unity is his prayer, not our project.

unity.drift: 'The unity of the Spirit': already given, to be kept -- not made.

unleavened.drift: Passover bread: no time to wait, no room for the old.

unrighteous.drift: 'There is none righteous': the bad news before the Good News.

upright.drift: Uprightness is straightness: no bends, no lean.

vain.drift: 'Do not take the LORD's name in vain': don't make it empty.

valley.ancient: A valley -- low, often dangerous ground.
valley.drift: 'The valley of the shadow of death': the lowest place, with the Shepherd in it.

vanity.drift: Ecclesiastes' theme: life without God is breath on a mirror.

veil.ancient: A curtain -- separating the holy from the most holy.
veil.drift: Torn at the cross: the barrier is down, the way is open.

vengeance.drift: 'Vengeance is mine, saith the Lord': justice is HIS job, not yours.

vessel.ancient: A container -- a jar, a pot.
vessel.drift: 'Vessels of mercy': you are a jar, made to carry treasure.

victory.drift: 'Thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory': given, not earned.

vine.ancient: A grapevine -- Israel's symbol, then Christ's.
vine.drift: 'I am the true vine': stay connected or wither.

vinegar.drift: Offered to Jesus on the cross: sour wine for the suffering King.

violence.ancient: Wrong, injustice -- violence against the innocent.
violence.drift: 'The earth was filled with violence' (Gen 6): the reason for the flood.

virgin.ancient: A young woman of marriageable age -- in prophecy, a virgin indeed.
virgin.drift: Isaiah 7:14's 'almah': young woman -- Matthew confirms virgin.

virtue.drift: 'Add to your faith virtue': excellence as a habit.

vision.ancient: A sight -- what is seen, especially from God.
vision.drift: 'Where there is no vision, the people perish': sight from God sustains.

voice.drift: 'The voice of the LORD is powerful': when he speaks, things happen.

vow.drift: 'Better not to vow than to vow and not pay': promises to God are serious.

wages.drift: 'The wages of sin is death': sin pays -- in death.

wait.ancient: To wait with tension -- like a watchman for morning.
wait.drift: Waiting is active: braided together with God like a rope (qavah).

walk.ancient: To walk -- the Bible's word for how you live.
walk.drift: 'Walk in the Spirit': life is a walk, not a sprint.

wall.drift: Jerusalem's walls: safety -- and Nehemiah rebuilt them with a trowel in one hand and a sword in the other.

wander.drift: 'All we like sheep have gone astray': wandering is our default.

war.drift: 'The LORD is a man of war': he fights for his people.

wash.drift: 'Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow': cleansing is God's work.

watch.drift: 'Watch and pray': the night watchman's job -- stay awake.

water.ancient: Water -- life in a dry land.
water.drift: 'Living water': Jesus's offer to the thirsty soul.

way.ancient: A road, a path -- and a way of life.
way.drift: Jesus IS the way: not a map, a person.

weak.drift: 'When I am weak, then am I strong': weakness is the doorway to his strength.

wealth.drift: Wealth is a tool and a test: 'rich toward God' is the goal.

weary.drift: 'They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength': weariness has a cure.

weep.drift: 'Jesus wept': the shortest verse, the deepest comfort.

well.ancient: A well, a spring -- water in the desert.
well.drift: Wells were worth fighting for: water is life.

wheat.drift: 'The wheat and the tares': the real and the fake grow together until harvest.

whirlwind.drift: God answered Job 'out of the whirlwind': he speaks in storms.

whole.drift: 'Love the Lord with all': wholeness, not halves.

whore.ancient: A prostitute -- and a symbol of unfaithfulness to God.
whore.drift: Hosea's wife, Babylon the great: unfaithfulness pictured as prostitution.

wicked.drift: 'The wicked': not just naughty -- guilty before God.

widow.drift: God's special clients: 'a father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows.'

wife.drift: Hebrew and Greek use one word for 'woman/wife': marriage makes the words overlap.

wild.drift: John the Baptist: wild honey, wild place, wild message.

wilderness.drift: Where God trains his people: Moses, Elijah, Jesus -- all did time in the wilderness.

wind.drift: 'The wind blows where it wishes': the Spirit is untamable.

wine.ancient: Fermented grape juice -- joy and excess.
wine.drift: 'Wine that maketh glad the heart': gift -- but 'wine is a mocker' in excess.

wings.drift: 'Under his wings shalt thou trust': the safest place is under the feathers.

wisdom.ancient: Skill for living well -- practical know-how for a good life.
wisdom.drift: Not IQ or trivia: it is knowing how to live. 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.'

wise.drift: The wise man built on rock: wisdom acts, not just knows.

witchcraft.ancient: Sorcery -- using spiritual power apart from God.
witchcraft.drift: Listed with idolatry as 'works of the flesh' (Gal 5): power without God.

witness.ancient: One who testifies -- in court or with your life.
witness.drift: Witness and martyr are ONE word: testimony could cost your life.

woe.ancient: An exclamation of grief or judgment -- 'alas!'
woe.drift: Jesus's 'woes' are the flip side of the 'blesseds': grief over what could have been.

wolf.drift: 'Wolves in sheep's clothing': danger dressed as safety.

woman.drift: Eve, 'mother of all living': honored from the first chapter.

womb.ancient: The womb -- and the seat of compassion (same root as 'mercy').
womb.drift: God's compassion is 'womb-love': tender as a mother for her child.

wonder.ancient: A marvel -- something that makes you stare.
wonder.drift: God's 'wonders': miracles that stop you in your tracks.

word.ancient: LOGOS: God's self-expression -- his message, his mind, his Son. Also RHEMA: the spoken word.
word.drift: 'In the beginning was the Word': Jesus is what God has to say.

work.drift: 'We are his workmanship': you are God's artwork, not his employee.

workmanship.ancient: A crafted thing -- a poem, a work of art.
workmanship.drift: You are God's POIEMA -- his poem, his masterpiece.

world.ancient: KOSMOS: the ordered world -- and the world system opposed to God. AION: the age.
world.drift: 'God so loved the world' (kosmos) -- yet 'do not love the world': same word, two uses.

worm.ancient: A worm, a maggot -- and the scarlet worm (tola), crushed for red dye.
worm.drift: 'I am a worm' (Ps 22): the scarlet worm dies to color others -- a picture of the cross.

worship.ancient: To bow down, to kiss toward -- to prostrate yourself.
worship.drift: Not singing songs: it is hitting the floor. Bowing low before a high God.

wrath.ancient: Anger -- God's settled opposition to evil.
wrath.drift: Not a temper tantrum: it is justice, personal and purposeful.

wretched.drift: 'O wretched man that I am!': Paul's cry -- and Christ's answer.

yoke.ancient: A wooden harness for oxen -- submission to a master.
yoke.drift: 'My yoke is easy': Jesus's yoke fits -- it was made for you.

zeal.drift: 'Zeal for thy house': passion that consumes -- aim it right.

zion.ancient: The hill of Jerusalem -- God's chosen city, his dwelling place.
zion.drift: From a Jebusite fortress to the picture of heaven itself.

yahuah.ancient: The personal name of God (YHWH), rendered Yahuah. Translated 'LORD' in most English Bibles.
yahuah.drift: Most Bibles hide the Name behind 'LORD'; the Hebrew uses it about 6,800 times.

yahweh.ancient: The personal name of God (YHWH), the common scholarly pronunciation.
yahweh.drift: Same Name as Yahuah/YHWH -- 'I am / He who is' (Exodus 3:14-15).

yhwh.ancient: The four Hebrew letters of God's personal Name (the Tetragrammaton).
yhwh.drift: Printed 'LORD' in capitals in the KJV wherever these letters stand.

yah.ancient: Short form of the Name YHWH, as in Hallelu-YAH.

yeshua.drift: 'Jesus' comes from the Greek Iesous via Latin; Yeshua is what his family called him.

yahusha.ancient: Sacred-name rendering of Jesus' Hebrew name: 'Yahuah is salvation'.

iesous.ancient: The Greek form of Jesus' name in the New Testament.
iesous.drift: Also used for Joshua in Acts 7:45 and Hebrews 4:8.

elohim.ancient: God, Mighty One -- plural form used with singular verbs for the one true God.
elohim.drift: Also used of 'gods' and judges; context shows when it means the true God.

el.drift: Found in names like El Shaddai, El Elyon, Isra-el.

eloah.ancient: God (singular of Elohim), common in Job.

elah.ancient: God (Aramaic), used in Daniel and Ezra.

adonai.ancient: My Lord -- a title of God meaning Master/Sovereign.
adonai.drift: Jews say 'Adonai' aloud in place of the Name YHWH.

adon.ancient: Lord, master -- used of God and of human masters.

shaddai.ancient: Almighty -- as in El Shaddai, 'God Almighty'.

elyon.ancient: Most High -- as in El Elyon, 'God Most High'.

theos.ancient: God -- the Greek New Testament word for God.
theos.drift: The Septuagint uses Theos for Elohim.

kurios.ancient: Lord, master -- used for Jesus, for God, and for human masters.
kurios.drift: The Septuagint uses Kurios in place of YHWH, so NT quotes of the LORD read Kurios.

hakodesh.ancient: 'The Holy' -- in Ruach HaKodesh, the Holy Spirit.

ehyeh.ancient: 'I AM / I will be' -- God's self-name in Exodus 3:14.
ehyeh.drift: Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh = 'I AM THAT I AM'.

pantokrator.drift: Greek of 'Lord God Almighty' in Revelation.
